root_cause: The datepicker's keydown listener prevents the default Tab action when the picker is open, causing focus to be lost instead of moving to the next form field.
repair_strategy: Modify the keydown listener in Datepicker.js to allow the Tab key to propagate when the datepicker is active, preserving default focus traversal while keeping other keyboard shortcuts intact.
expected_accessibility_effect: Users can now press Tab to move focus from the visit date field to the access notes field while the datepicker is open, enabling keyboard-only navigation through the form.
functional_risks: Potential interference with any custom Shift+Tab handling (though only Tab is altered).
If other code relied on Tab being suppressed to keep focus inside the picker, that behavior will change.
verification_requirements: Verify that Tab moves focus from #visit-date to #notes when the datepicker is open.
Verify that ArrowRight and Enter still change the date as expected.
Verify that Escape still closes the picker.
Verify that Tab behaves normally when the picker is closed.
